hero.title: Your Huawei modem, finally under control
hero.sub: Monitor signal strength, lock LTE bands, manage WiFi devices and SMS — all local, all private, no cloud. Tested on the Orbit Star 2 B312-929.

features.label: What it does
features.title: Everything the stock Web UI can't
features.sub: The modem's built-in interface hides most of what the device can do. Huawei Manager opens it up.

dashboard.title: Realtime dashboard
dashboard.desc: Signal (RSSI, RSRP, RSRQ, SINR, band), traffic speedometer, connection status and power source at a glance.

signalFinder.title: Signal Finder
signalFinder.desc: Rotate or reposition the modem while watching live metrics to find the strongest spot.

bandLock.title: LTE Band Lock
bandLock.desc: Pick specific LTE bands, including 5G NR and carrier aggregation combos like B3+B1+N40.

wifi.title: WiFi device control
wifi.desc: List connected devices with vendor icons, kick or block devices, rename them, see 2.4/5 GHz and lease time.

guest.title: Guest WiFi
guest.desc: Second SSID with a time limit. Extend in 30-minute steps from the app.

parental.title: Parental controls
parental.desc: Per-device schedules by day and time range. Cut internet at bedtime automatically.

sms.title: SMS management
sms.desc: Read, compose, send and delete SMS, with unread count and search. When the modem supports it.

network.title: Network & APN
network.desc: APN profiles, mobile data toggle, Ethernet, DHCP and PPPoE configuration.

widget.title: Home screen widget
widget.desc: Signal and traffic status right on your home screen, refreshed hourly.

notify.title: Usage alerts
notify.desc: Push notifications when daily or monthly data hits your threshold, when the IP changes, or a new version lands.

speedtest.title: Speed test
speedtest.desc: In-app internet speed test plus quick actions for the things you toggle most.

debug.title: Debug mode
debug.desc: Log every API call and export a HAR file to report issues precisely.

privacy.title: Private by design
privacy.desc: The app talks directly to your modem over WiFi. No account, no data collection, no cloud.

how.label: How it works
how.title: Three steps, no root
how.sub: If you can open the modem's admin page in a browser, this app can control it.

step1.title: Connect to the modem
step1.desc: Join the modem's WiFi network, just like you do for the admin page.

step2.title: Log in
step2.desc: Use the same username and password as the Web UI. The app auto-detects the modem IP (192.168.8.1).

step3.title: Monitor & control
step3.desc: Signal, bands, devices, SMS, quota — everything in one place.

modems.label: Compatibility
modems.title: Works with any Huawei LTE router
modems.sub: Any device exposing the classic Huawei XML API on 192.168.8.1 — tested on the Orbit Star 2.
modems.generic: Any Huawei LTE modem with the XML API
modems.note: SMS and some settings depend on what the specific modem exposes.

download.label: Download
download.title: Get Huawei Manager
download.sub: Three architectures, all free. No ads in core features.

items.a: No. The app talks to the modem's local API over your WiFi — no root, no cloud account.
Any Huawei LTE router that exposes the classic XML API — B310, B311, B312, B525, B535, B818, E5573, E5577 and more. The Orbit Star 2 (B312-929) is tested and popular in Indonesia.
No. Everything runs locally between your phone and the modem. There is no account and no analytics server.
Ads cover the push-notification server costs. Core features stay free and ad-free.

items.q: My modem doesn't support SMS. Why?
items.a: SMS depends on the modem's firmware. The app hides the feature when the API doesn't expose it.
Not yet. The app is Android-only today, built with Expo so iOS is possible in the future.
